english:
Breaking a Combatant's Shield for the first time, or the Shield of a Guardian in their Super, spawns an Orb of Power that grants 7.15% Super Energy.

Performing a Finisher on a Combatant that did not trigger this effect also spawns an Orb of Power.

Picking up an Orb of Power or an Elemental Pickup, or destroying a <strand Tangle />, restores 40 HP.

Heals have a 0.3 second cooldown between them.

source.text:
Upon first breaking a Combatant Shield, or a Supering Guardian's Shield:

Creates an Orb of Power that grants 7.15% Super Energy.
Performing a Finisher on a Combatant that didn't trigger the effect will also spawn an Orb of Power.

Upon picking up an Orb of Power, an Elemental Pickup, or destroying a Tangle:
Restores 40 HP.
Incurs a 0.3 seconds cooldown between heals.
